title: myosotis scorpioides var. praecox
intro: Myosotis scorpioides var. praecox, commonly known as early forget-me-not, is a perennial plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). Early forget-me-not is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of early forget-me-not include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and medicinal applications.
